profile.summary: MohammedBelkacem is a Junior-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in the Moment.js date library. Their contributions focus exclusively on extending Moment.js with new locale files, demonstrating strong proficiency in modular JavaScript development and ES6+ features. While their experience is highly specialized in date/time handling, there is no evidence of modern frontend frameworks (React/Vue), backend systems (Node.js), or advanced JavaScript concepts beyond what is required for Moment.js internals. Their contributions show basic awareness of testing needs but lack hands-on experience with testing frameworks or modern build tools. MohammedBelkacem would benefit from expanding their skill set into broader frontend development, backend systems, and testing methodologies to progress beyond their current specialized niche.
